constraints.definition: CHECK (((started_at IS NULL) OR (finished_at IS NULL) OR (finished_at >= started_at)))

constraints.name: reading_entries_content_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (((page_to IS NOT NULL) OR (note IS NOT NULL)))

constraints.name: reading_entries_pages_check
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((page_from IS NULL) OR ((page_from >= 0) AND (page_from <= 100000))) AND ((page_to IS NULL) OR ((page_to >= 0) AND (page_to <= 100000))) AND ((page_from IS NULL) OR ((page_to IS NOT NULL) AND (page_from <= page_to)))))

constraints.name: loans_borrower_label_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (((char_length(borrower_label) >= 1) AND (char_length(borrower_label) <= 40) AND (borrower_label = btrim(borrower_label)) AND (borrower_label !~ '[[:cntrl:]]'::text) AND (strpos(borrower_label, '@'::text) = 0) AND (char_length(regexp_replace(borrower_label, '[^0-9]'::text, ''::text, 'g'::text)) <= 6)))

constraints.name: loans_dates_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (((loaned_on >= '1900-01-01'::date) AND (loaned_on <= '2999-12-31'::date) AND ((due_on IS NULL) OR ((due_on >= loaned_on) AND (due_on <= '2999-12-31'::date))) AND ((returned_on IS NULL) OR ((returned_on >= loaned_on) AND (returned_on <= '2999-12-31'::date)))))

constraints.name: account_deletions_completed_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (((state = 'completed'::text) = ((completed_at IS NOT NULL) AND (purge_after IS NOT NULL) AND (step = 'done'::text))))

constraints.name: editions_isbn13_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (((isbn13 IS NULL) OR (NOT (biblib.isbn13_normalize(isbn13) IS DISTINCT FROM isbn13))))

constraints.name: copy_locations_shelf_label_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (((shelf_label IS NULL) OR ((char_length(shelf_label) >= 1) AND (char_length(shelf_label) <= 60) AND (shelf_label = btrim(shelf_label)))))

constraints.name: cover_assets_ready_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (((state = 'quarantine'::text) OR ((storage_key IS NOT NULL) AND (sha256 IS NOT NULL) AND (mime = 'image/webp'::text) AND (width IS NOT NULL) AND (height IS NOT NULL) AND (bytes IS NOT NULL))))

constraints.name: cover_assets_size_check
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((bytes IS NULL) OR ((bytes >= 1) AND (bytes <= 5242880))) AND ((width IS NULL) OR ((width >= 1) AND (width <= 10000))) AND ((height IS NULL) OR ((height >= 1) AND (height <= 10000)))))

constraints.name: series_editions_position_check
constraints.definition: CHECK ((("position" IS NULL) OR (("position" >= (0)::numeric) AND ("position" < (1000000)::numeric) AND (scale("position") <= 4))))

constraints.name: import_session_rows_source_check
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((source_ordinal IS NULL) = (source_row_key IS NULL)) AND ((source_ordinal IS NULL) OR ((source_ordinal >= 1) AND (source_ordinal <= 1000000) AND (source_row_key ~ '^[A-Za-z0-9:_-]{1,128}$'::text)))))

constraints.name: import_sessions_csv_hashes_check
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((input_sha256 IS NULL) OR (input_sha256 ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'::text)) AND ((mapping_sha256 IS NULL) OR (mapping_sha256 ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'::text))))

constraints.name: import_sessions_csv_mapping_check
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((csv_mapping IS NULL) = (csv_mapping_version IS NULL)) AND ((csv_mapping IS NULL) = (mapping_sha256 IS NULL))))

constraints.name: import_sessions_csv_mapping_shape_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (((csv_mapping IS NULL) OR ((jsonb_typeof(csv_mapping) = 'object'::text) AND (octet_length((csv_mapping)::text) <= 16384) AND (csv_mapping_version >= 1))))

constraints.name: import_sessions_csv_source_check
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((source = 'csv'::text) = (input_sha256 IS NOT NULL)) AND ((source = 'csv'::text) OR (csv_mapping IS NULL))))

constraints.name: import_sessions_prepared_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (((state <> ALL (ARRAY['prepared'::text, 'committed'::text])) OR (preview_id IS NOT NULL)))

constraints.name: import_sessions_preview_check
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((preview_id IS NULL) = (preview_revision IS NULL)) AND ((preview_id IS NULL) = (preview_expires_at IS NULL)) AND ((preview_id IS NULL) = (plan IS NULL))))

constraints.name: library_jobs_import_check

constraints.name: library_jobs_lease_check

functions.body:
DECLARE
  owner_id uuid := auth.uid();
  found uuid[];
BEGIN
  IF owner_id IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'library_snapshot_foreign_ids requiere una sesión' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;
  WITH entry AS (
    SELECT c.kind, item, (item->>'id')::uuid AS id, coalesce(item->>'edition_id', item->>'id')::uuid AS edition_id, (item->>'work_id')::uuid AS work_id
    FROM biblib.library_snapshot_chunks AS c CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(c.payload) AS item
    WHERE c.snapshot_id = p_snapshot_id AND c.user_id = owner_id
  ), evidence AS (
    SELECT (ev->>'id')::uuid AS id FROM entry CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(entry.item->'evidence', '[]'::jsonb) || coalesce(entry.item->'edition_evidence', '[]'::jsonb)) AS ev
    WHERE entry.kind = 'books'
  ), cycle AS (
    SELECT (cy->>'id')::uuid AS id, cy FROM entry CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(entry.item->'reading', '[]'::jsonb)) AS cy
    WHERE entry.kind = 'books'
  ), reading_entry AS (
    SELECT (re->>'id')::uuid AS id FROM cycle CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(cycle.cy->'entries', '[]'::jsonb)) AS re
  ), loan AS (
    SELECT (lo->>'id')::uuid AS id FROM entry CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(entry.item->'loans', '[]'::jsonb)) AS lo
    WHERE entry.kind = 'books'
  ), taken AS (
    SELECT entry.id FROM entry WHERE entry.kind = 'books' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM biblib.copies AS cp WHERE cp.id = entry.id AND cp.user_id <> owner_id)
    UNION
    SELECT entry.edition_id FROM entry WHERE entry.kind = 'books' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM biblib.editions AS e WHERE e.id = entry.edition_id AND e.user_id <> owner_id)
    UNION
    SELECT entry.work_id FROM entry WHERE entry.kind = 'books' AND entry.work_id IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM biblib.works AS w WHERE w.id = entry.work_id AND w.user_id <> owner_id)
    UNION
    SELECT entry.id FROM entry WHERE entry.kind = 'shelves' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM biblib.shelves AS sh WHERE sh.id = entry.id AND sh.user_id <> owner_id)
    UNION
    SELECT entry.id FROM entry WHERE entry.kind = 'tags' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM biblib.tags AS t WHERE t.id = entry.id AND t.user_id <> owner_id)
    UNION
    SELECT entry.id FROM entry WHERE entry.kind = 'locations' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM biblib.locations AS l WHERE l.id = entry.id AND l.user_id <> owner_id)
    UNION
    SELECT entry.id FROM entry WHERE entry.kind = 'series' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM biblib.series AS se WHERE se.id = entry.id AND se.user_id <> owner_id)
    UNION
    SELECT evidence.id FROM evidence WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM biblib.bibliographic_evidence AS ev WHERE ev.id = evidence.id AND ev.user_id <> owner_id)
    UNION
    SELECT cycle.id FROM cycle WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM biblib.reading_cycles AS r WHERE r.id = cycle.id AND r.user_id <> owner_id)
    UNION
    SELECT reading_entry.id FROM reading_entry WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM biblib.reading_entries AS r WHERE r.id = reading_entry.id AND r.user_id <> owner_id)
    UNION
    SELECT loan.id FROM loan WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM biblib.loans AS l WHERE l.id = loan.id AND l.user_id <> owner_id)
  )
  SELECT coalesce(array_agg(taken.id ORDER BY taken.id), '{}'::uuid[]) INTO found FROM taken;
  RETURN found;
END;

functions.body:
DECLARE
  result jsonb;
BEGIN
  WITH legacy AS (
    SELECT b.* FROM biblib.books_legacy AS b WHERE p_owner IS NULL OR b.user_id = p_owner
  ), model AS (
    SELECT c.id, c.user_id, c.status, c.shelf_id, c.created_at, c.legacy_identifier, c.edition_verification, e.isbn13, e.title, e.subtitle,
      e.authors, e.publishers, e.number_of_pages, e.publish_date, e.catalogue, e.cover_small, e.cover_medium, e.cover_large, e.cover_asset_id
    FROM biblib.copies AS c JOIN biblib.editions AS e ON e.user_id = c.user_id AND e.id = c.edition_id
    WHERE p_owner IS NULL OR c.user_id = p_owner
  ), diff AS (
    SELECT coalesce(l.id, m.id) AS id
    FROM legacy AS l FULL JOIN model AS m ON m.id = l.id
    WHERE NOT coalesce(l.id IS NOT NULL AND m.id IS NOT NULL AND l.user_id = m.user_id
      AND (l.isbn = coalesce(m.legacy_identifier, m.isbn13)
        OR (m.legacy_identifier IS NULL AND m.isbn13 = biblib.isbn13_normalize(l.isbn))
        OR (btrim(l.isbn) = '' AND m.legacy_identifier IS NULL AND m.isbn13 IS NULL))
      AND l.title = m.title AND l.subtitle IS NOT DISTINCT FROM m.subtitle AND l.authors = m.authors AND l.publishers = m.publishers
      AND l.number_of_pages = m.number_of_pages AND l.publish_date = m.publish_date
      AND l.cover_small = m.cover_small AND l.cover_medium = m.cover_medium AND l.cover_large = m.cover_large
      AND l.cover_asset_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM m.cover_asset_id
      AND l.status = m.status AND l.shelf_id = m.shelf_id AND l.created_at = m.created_at
      AND l.catalogue - 'isbnVerified' = m.catalogue
      AND coalesce(l.catalogue->'isbnVerified' = 'true'::jsonb, false) = (m.edition_verification->'isbnVerified' = 'true'::jsonb), false)
  )
  SELECT jsonb_build_object(
    'books', (SELECT count(*) FROM legacy),
    'copies', (SELECT count(*) FROM model),
    'editions', (SELECT count(*) FROM biblib.editions AS e WHERE p_owner IS NULL OR e.user_id = p_owner),
    'works', (SELECT count(*) FROM biblib.works AS w WHERE p_owner IS NULL OR w.user_id = p_owner),
    'accounts', (SELECT count(DISTINCT l.user_id) FROM legacy AS l),
    'mismatches', (SELECT count(*) FROM diff),
    'sample', coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(d.id ORDER BY d.id) FROM (SELECT id FROM diff ORDER BY id LIMIT 20) AS d), '[]'::jsonb))
  INTO result;
  RETURN result;
END;

  RETURN CASE p_step
    WHEN 'covers' THEN ARRAY['cover_assets']
    WHEN 'snapshots' THEN ARRAY['library_snapshot_chunks', 'library_snapshots']
    WHEN 'staging' THEN ARRAY['import_session_rows', 'import_session_chunks', 'import_session_parts', 'import_sessions']

    WHEN 'views' THEN ARRAY['saved_book_views']

    WHEN 'operations' THEN ARRAY['library_operations']
    WHEN 'private_cache' THEN ARRAY['catalogue_private_cache', 'catalogue_quota_reservations']
    WHEN 'product' THEN ARRAY['reading_entries', 'reading_cycles', 'loans', 'review_decisions', 'review_issues', 'bibliographic_evidence', 'copy_tags', 'copy_annotations', 'copy_locations', 'series_editions', 'tags', 'locations', 'series', 'csv_mapping_profiles', 'profiles']

    WHEN 'editions' THEN ARRAY['editions']
    WHEN 'works' THEN ARRAY['works']
    WHEN 'shelves' THEN ARRAY['shelves']
    WHEN 'state' THEN ARRAY['library_state', 'model_migration_report', 'books_legacy']
    ELSE NULL
  END;
END;
